_comment: Hand-checked corrections to the free-tier figures in the vendored OmniRoute roster.
The roster is a second-hand source and one of its numbers is wrong: for `llm7` it records
150M tokens/month where LLM7 publishes 100,000 tokens per rolling 24 hours — a bar drawn
against the roster's figure tells an account that has spent its whole allowance that it
still has room. Entries here are read by `lib/providers/omniroute.js` at registration and
replace only the fields they name, so the roster's attribution stays wherever no correction
exists. Every entry carries the URL and date it was checked against, because a correction
without evidence is just a second guess.

llm7.source: LLM7 publishes 100,000 tokens per rolling 24 hours for a free token, at 1 request/s, 60/min and 250/hour, and the allowance covers only the `turbo` models — 4 of the 68 ids its /v1/models lists; the other 64 are pro or usage-billed. Anonymous calls with no key still answered on 2026-11-08, but LLM7 publishes no budget for them.
llm7.numericSource: LLM7 limits doc (read 2026-11-08); replaces the roster's 150M tokens/month, which is ~50x the published cap
